# kestrel Apify Actors

> Structured public web data through Apify MCP and REST APIs. 57 published Actors; status, prices and schemas checked 2026-11-07.

## Start here

- [Agent setup](https://mtedj.github.io/kestrel-actors-examples/agents/): focused MCP toolkits
- [Workflow guide](https://mtedj.github.io/kestrel-actors-examples/agents/guide.md): selection, authentication, spending limits and results
- [JSON catalog](https://mtedj.github.io/kestrel-actors-examples/agents/catalog.json): Actor IDs, descriptions, status, prices, schema URLs

## Actors

- [kestrel/agoda-prices-scraper](https://mtedj.github.io/kestrel-actors-examples/agents/agoda-prices-scraper/): Agoda hotel prices and availability for destinations or hotels by URL, id or name. One row per hotel: nightly and total price, taxes, free cancellation, rooms left, stars, guest score, sold out. Price calendar: cheapest dates. Filters before billing: max price, stars, guest score. ราคาโรงแรม, ホテル料金
- [kestrel/agoda-reviews-scraper](https://mtedj.github.io/kestrel-actors-examples/agents/agoda-reviews-scraper/): Agoda hotel reviews by hotel name, URL or id, with the Booking.com reviews Agoda shows. One row per review: 0-10 rating, title, text, positives, negatives, language, stay dates, room, reviewer country, photos, hotel reply, source. Free filters before billing: max score (negative reviews), text only.
- [kestrel/airbnb-occupancy-scraper](https://mtedj.github.io/kestrel-actors-examples/agents/airbnb-occupancy-scraper/): Estimate Airbnb occupancy from listing availability calendars by place or listing ID. One row per listing and month: available and blocked-or-booked days, occupancy %, minimum stay and sampled nightly rate. For rental market research and comps; blocked nights cannot be separated from bookings.
- [kestrel/airbnb-prices-calendar](https://mtedj.github.io/kestrel-actors-examples/agents/airbnb-prices-calendar/): Airbnb vacation rental listings and prices by place, URL or ID for your dates and guests. Rows: nightly rate, stay total, rating, bedrooms, Superhost, photos. Optional 24-month availability calendar and reviews. Free details: amenities, house rules, host, price breakdown. No daily calendar prices.
- [kestrel/airbnb-reviews-scraper](https://mtedj.github.io/kestrel-actors-examples/agents/airbnb-reviews-scraper/): Airbnb vacation rental guest reviews by URL, id or place. One row per review: rating, text, host replies, translation, language, date, reviewer, location. Lowest rated first and minRating keep only negative reviews (complaints) and bill only those. For sentiment, reputation, competitor research.
- [kestrel/aliexpress-reviews-scraper](https://mtedj.github.io/kestrel-actors-examples/agents/aliexpress-reviews-scraper/): Scrape AliExpress product reviews by URL or item id: star rating, buyer feedback translated into 16 languages, buyer photos, country, SKU variant. Date, keyword and star filters, new-review monitoring, free sentiment analysis. For dropshipping product research. No login. API and MCP ready.
- [kestrel/amazon-best-sellers-scraper](https://mtedj.github.io/kestrel-actors-examples/agents/amazon-best-sellers-scraper/): Amazon Best Sellers and New Releases charts by category in 20 marketplaces, every rank: 2 pages = the Top 100. One row per chart entry: best seller rank (BSR), ASIN, title, price, rating, ratings count, image. Free: minimum rating filter, top-N cap. Track sales rank daily, spot trending products.
- [kestrel/amazon-product-scraper](https://mtedj.github.io/kestrel-actors-examples/agents/amazon-product-scraper/): Amazon product details by ASIN or URL, 20 marketplaces. One row per product: title, brand, buybox price, list price, availability, in stock, rating, ratings count, images, bullet points, description, details table, Best Sellers Rank (BSR). Free filters: in stock only, max price. No login.
- [kestrel/amazon-reviews-scraper](https://mtedj.github.io/kestrel-actors-examples/agents/amazon-reviews-scraper/): Amazon product-page reviews by ASIN or URL. UK examples verified; US reviews currently hit a sign-in wall. One review row: rating, text, date, author, verified purchase and helpful votes. Optional product ratings. Public-page samples only, not full history; availability varies by marketplace.
- [kestrel/amazon-search-scraper](https://mtedj.github.io/kestrel-actors-examples/agents/amazon-search-scraper/): Amazon search results by keyword in 20 marketplaces, plus Best Sellers and New Releases charts. One row per product: ASIN, title, price, rating, ratings count, image, sponsored flag, position on the page, chart rank. Free filters: skip sponsored (organic results), min rating, department.
- [kestrel/app-store-reviews-scraper](https://mtedj.github.io/kestrel-actors-examples/agents/app-store-reviews-scraper/): Get Apple App Store reviews by app ID, URL or name across country storefronts. Rows: rating, title, text, reviewer, date, app version and developer replies. Free app ratings and review counts. Filter negative reviews, star ratings, text and since date before billing. For iOS app feedback monitoring.
- [kestrel/ashby-jobs-scraper](https://mtedj.github.io/kestrel-actors-examples/agents/ashby-jobs-scraper/): Get Ashby jobs from company board URLs or tokens. One row per job: title, location, department, full description, apply URL, dates and published salaries. Filter titles, locations, remote or hybrid jobs before billing. Exclude known job IDs for new jobs. No login or API key needed.
- [kestrel/booking-prices-scraper](https://mtedj.github.io/kestrel-actors-examples/agents/booking-prices-scraper/): Booking.com prices and availability by date for destinations or hotels by URL, name or id. One row per hotel: stay total, nightly rate, taxes, free cancellation, breakfast, stars, review score, sold out. Optional room rates. Filters before billing: max price, star class. Price tracking, comp sets.
- [kestrel/booking-reviews-scraper](https://mtedj.github.io/kestrel-actors-examples/agents/booking-reviews-scraper/): Booking.com guest reviews by URL, name or id. One row per review: score, title, liked/disliked, language, review/stay dates, room, traveller type, country, photos, property reply. Free hotel row: score, 7 category ratings. Free filters: language, keyword, max score (negative reviews), since date.
- [kestrel/clinical-trials-search](https://mtedj.github.io/kestrel-actors-examples/agents/clinical-trials-search/): Search clinical trials on ClinicalTrials.gov by query and recruitment status. Rows: NCT ID, title, sponsor, conditions, phase, enrollment, eligibility, locations and public study contacts. Free country/text filters; exclude known IDs or content hashes for repeat-run research. 临床试验。
- [kestrel/despegar-hotel-ratings](https://mtedj.github.io/kestrel-actors-examples/agents/despegar-hotel-ratings/): Get Despegar hotel ratings by hotel URL or ID in Latin America. One row per hotel: guest score, review count, six category scores, stars, city and Despegar AI review summary. Free: up to four published comments, not a full review list. Filter minimum rating. Opiniones y calificaciones de hoteles.
- [kestrel/ebay-search-scraper](https://mtedj.github.io/kestrel-actors-examples/agents/ebay-search-scraper/): Search active eBay listings by keyword or search URL on 10 marketplaces. Rows: prices, shipping, condition, auctions, bids, units sold, watchers and seller feedback. Free filters: condition, format, price, category, sort. Item-page details are currently unreliable. UK and sold history unsupported.
- [kestrel/flight-price-tracker](https://mtedj.github.io/kestrel-actors-examples/agents/flight-price-tracker/): Track Google Flights fares across 1–60 departure dates per route. One row per day: cheapest price, airline, stops and rank. Flight price calendar for one-way or round trips, with nonstop and max-price filters. Schedule snapshots for price history; threshold rows do not send notifications.
- [kestrel/google-ads-transparency-scraper](https://mtedj.github.io/kestrel-actors-examples/agents/google-ads-transparency-scraper/): Search the Google Ads Transparency ad library by domain or advertiser ID. Rows: advertiser, creative ID, format, dates, previews and optional OCR ad copy. Monitor new or changed competitor ads; filter region and date. No login. Domain matches do not prove ownership; missing text is reported.
- [kestrel/google-autocomplete-keywords](https://mtedj.github.io/kestrel-actors-examples/agents/google-autocomplete-keywords/): Get Google autocomplete keyword suggestions from seed queries, country and language. One row per suggestion: seed, expanded query, text, position and locale. Optional a-z seed expansion, text filters and new-only monitoring. Parsed queries are billed even when no suggestions remain.
- [kestrel/google-flights-prices](https://mtedj.github.io/kestrel-actors-examples/agents/google-flights-prices/): Get Google Flights prices by route, dates, cabin and passengers. One row per itinerary: price, airline, times, duration, stops, layovers, CO2. One-way or round trip; nonstop and business class fares. Sweep dates for a fare calendar. Schedule daily flight price tracking to build price history.
- [kestrel/google-hotels-prices](https://mtedj.github.io/kestrel-actors-examples/agents/google-hotels-prices/): Google Hotels API: hotel prices by city, hotel name or URL for your dates. One row per hotel: nightly rate, stay total, taxes, deals, availability, rating. Optional OTA rates (Booking.com, Expedia, Agoda, official site): rate parity, price comparison, price tracking. Free: address, phone, amenities.
- [kestrel/google-maps-reviews-scraper](https://mtedj.github.io/kestrel-actors-examples/agents/google-maps-reviews-scraper/): Google Maps reviews by place id, URL, short link or name. One row per review: stars, text, owner replies, exact dates, translation, photos, reviewer. Free place row: rating, review count, completeness check. Free filters: date range, only new reviews, negative reviews, text-only, keywords, language.
- [kestrel/google-maps-scraper](https://mtedj.github.io/kestrel-actors-examples/agents/google-maps-scraper/): Google Maps places and business leads by keyword and location: phone, website, rating, hours, place ID. Optional website emails and social links. Email-only mode bills only delivered places with emails. Count after free filters: no website, low rated, unclaimed. Newly seen place monitoring.
- [kestrel/google-news](https://mtedj.github.io/kestrel-actors-examples/agents/google-news/): Search Google News articles by keyword, country and language, including Chinese. One row per article: headline, publisher, publication date and Google News link. Filter dates and publisher domains before billing; exclude known IDs. RSS metadata only, not full text or direct publisher article URLs.
- [kestrel/google-patents-search](https://mtedj.github.io/kestrel-actors-examples/agents/google-patents-search/): Search Google Patents by keywords and patent office. One row per patent: publication number, title, inventor, assignee, priority, filing and publication dates, snippet and PDF link when available. Free text filters and ID/hash exclusions. Search metadata only; full claims are not extracted. 专利检索。
- [kestrel/google-play-reviews-scraper](https://mtedj.github.io/kestrel-actors-examples/agents/google-play-reviews-scraper/): Play Store reviews by language and country for Android apps by package name or URL. One row per review: 1-5 rating, text, reviewer, thumbs-up, app version, developer reply. Free app row: Google Play ratings. Filters before billing: star rating (negative, one-star reviews), since date (new reviews).
- [kestrel/google-search-rank-tracker](https://mtedj.github.io/kestrel-actors-examples/agents/google-search-rank-tracker/): Track Google Search domain rankings and organic SERP positions by keyword and country. Rows: domain, title, snippet, rank and result link. Filter domains and titles; monitor previous rank and movement. Parsed pages are billed even when filters or unchanged rankings leave no rows.
- [kestrel/google-shopping-products](https://mtedj.github.io/kestrel-actors-examples/agents/google-shopping-products/): Search Google Shopping products by keyword and country. One row per product offer: title, price, currency, merchant, rating and delivery text. Merchant and price filters; monitor price changes between runs. Parsed pages are billed even when filters or unchanged prices leave no rows.
- [kestrel/greenhouse-jobs-scraper](https://mtedj.github.io/kestrel-actors-examples/agents/greenhouse-jobs-scraper/): Get Greenhouse job postings from company board URLs or tokens. One row per job: title, location, department, full description, apply URL, dates and published salaries. Filter titles, departments, remote or hybrid jobs before billing. Exclude known job IDs for new jobs. No login or API key.
- [kestrel/hostelworld-reviews-scraper](https://mtedj.github.io/kestrel-actors-examples/agents/hostelworld-reviews-scraper/): Get Hostelworld hostel and backpacker reviews by property URL or ID. Each review includes score, safety, location, staff and cleanliness ratings, text, owner reply, group type, age, nationality and date. Free hostel row: address, lowest price. Filters: negative reviews, dates and group type.
- [kestrel/hotel-price-tracker](https://mtedj.github.io/kestrel-actors-examples/agents/hotel-price-tracker/): Track hotel prices on Google Hotels by name or URL across up to 60 dates. Each hotel/date row has lowest nightly rate, total, cheapest source and link, cancellation and cheapest date. Price calendar and rate monitoring; scheduled runs build price history. maxPrice filters rows for price-drop alerts.
- [kestrel/hotel-rate-parity](https://mtedj.github.io/kestrel-actors-examples/agents/hotel-rate-parity/): Check hotel rate parity on Google Hotels by name or URL. Each stay compares OTA and official site rates: nightly price, cancellation, booking link, cheapest source, spread and direct booking rate. Find parity violations: who undercuts the hotel and by how much. Available rates only; rate shopping.
- [kestrel/hotel-reputation-checker](https://mtedj.github.io/kestrel-actors-examples/agents/hotel-reputation-checker/): Compare hotel ratings across Google Hotels, Tripadvisor, Booking.com, Agoda, Hostelworld and Despegar. Free hotel reputation check: rating, 0-5 score, review count, stars, ranking and comparison summary. Up to 10 hotels per run. Use names for four sources; Hostelworld and Despegar need URLs.
- [kestrel/hrs-reviews-scraper](https://mtedj.github.io/kestrel-actors-examples/agents/hrs-reviews-scraper/): Get HRS hotel reviews by URL or hotel ID. Each guest review includes 0-10 rating, 12 category scores, positives, negatives, hotel reply, traveller type, stay dates, language and text. Free hotel row: stars, address. Filters: complaints, negative reviews, business travel, German. Hotelbewertungen.
- [kestrel/image-to-text-ocr](https://mtedj.github.io/kestrel-actors-examples/agents/image-to-text-ocr/): Extract printed text from public image URLs with English or simplified Chinese OCR. One row per nonempty image: text, words, confidence, bounding boxes, language and TXT download URL. Free empty images and ID/hash exclusions. 图片文字识别。 Handwriting recognition is not guaranteed.
- [kestrel/indeed-company-reviews](https://mtedj.github.io/kestrel-actors-examples/agents/indeed-company-reviews/): Scrape Indeed company reviews (employer reviews) by name or URL. One row per employee review: rating, 5 sub-ratings, text, pros, cons, job title, location, employer reply. Free: employer ratings, industry, size. Filters: rating, date, job title, location. Only-new mode for monitoring. 44 countries.
- [kestrel/kurzurlaub-reviews-scraper](https://mtedj.github.io/kestrel-actors-examples/agents/kurzurlaub-reviews-scraper/): German Kurzurlaub.de hotel reviews by URL or hotel id. One row per guest rating: 1-6 score, category scores (room, service, food, wellness, location, value), title, comments, date. Free hotel row: stars, city. Free filters: complaints, only new since a date. Kurzurlaub Bewertungen, Hotelbewertungen.
- [kestrel/linkedin-job-search](https://mtedj.github.io/kestrel-actors-examples/agents/linkedin-job-search/): Search LinkedIn jobs by keyword and location. Each job includes title, company, location, posted date, URL and available salary text. Optional job descriptions and employment types. Filter company, title and date; monitor new jobs. Parsed pages are billed even when no rows match.
- [kestrel/pdf-to-excel-tables](https://mtedj.github.io/kestrel-actors-examples/agents/pdf-to-excel-tables/): Extract tables from digital PDF URLs into Excel spreadsheets and XLSX downloads. One row per page with tables: cells, table count, page number, strategy and download URL. Choose ruled lines or text alignment. Free empty pages and ID/hash exclusions. PDF转Excel。 Scanned-table OCR is unsupported.
- [kestrel/pdf-to-markdown-pages](https://mtedj.github.io/kestrel-actors-examples/agents/pdf-to-markdown-pages/): Convert public PDF URLs to Markdown with page text extraction. Each nonempty page includes text, page number, extraction method, dimensions and download URL. Optional English/Chinese OCR for scanned pages without text. Free blank pages and ID/hash exclusions; page ranges. PDF转Markdown、扫描PDF识别。
- [kestrel/pinterest-pin-search](https://mtedj.github.io/kestrel-actors-examples/agents/pinterest-pin-search/): Search Pinterest pins by keywords. One row per pin: title, description, image URL, dimensions, destination URL, domain, board name and date. Filter text, image orientation and destination domains; collect only new pins. Parsed pages are billed even when filters or monitoring return no rows.
- [kestrel/rss-atom-feed-reader](https://mtedj.github.io/kestrel-actors-examples/agents/rss-atom-feed-reader/): Parse RSS and Atom feeds from URLs. Each article entry includes title, link, feed text, author, dates, categories and stable ID. Filter titles and dates; exclude known IDs for new items on repeat runs. Successful feed checks are billed even with no new items. No article crawling or login.
- [kestrel/sec-company-filings](https://mtedj.github.io/kestrel-actors-examples/agents/sec-company-filings/): Collect SEC EDGAR filings by company CIK: 10-K, 10-Q, 8-K and other forms. Each filing includes company, accession number, form, filing/report dates and original document link. Free date/form filters and ID/hash exclusions. Bounded archive pages; no filing-text extraction. 公司公告、财报。
- [kestrel/shopify-products](https://mtedj.github.io/kestrel-actors-examples/agents/shopify-products/): Get Shopify product catalogs from store URLs or a collection. Each product includes prices, currency, variants, SKUs, availability, images, vendor and descriptions. Filter titles, vendors and available products before billing. Exclude known IDs for new products. No login or API key needed.
- [kestrel/sitemap-url-extractor](https://mtedj.github.io/kestrel-actors-examples/agents/sitemap-url-extractor/): Extract URLs from XML sitemaps, gzip files and nested sitemap indexes. Each URL includes link, lastmod, priority, change frequency and source sitemap. Filter paths and last-modified dates; exclude known IDs for repeat runs. Source parsing is billed even with zero matches. No browser or proxy.
- [kestrel/steam-player-reviews](https://mtedj.github.io/kestrel-actors-examples/agents/steam-player-reviews/): Collect Steam player reviews by App ID and language. Each review includes text, dates, positive/negative recommendation, helpful votes and playtime. Free date/text filters and ID/hash exclusions. 中文评论。 Cursor pagination; no profile enrichment or comment replies.
- [kestrel/trip-com-reviews-scraper](https://mtedj.github.io/kestrel-actors-examples/agents/trip-com-reviews-scraper/): Trip.com and Ctrip (携程) hotel guest reviews by URL or id. One row per review: 0-10 rating, 4 sub-scores, text, stay date, room, travel type, reviewer country, photos, hotel reply, source. Free hotel row: stars, address, scores. Filters before billing: language, max score (negative reviews). 酒店点评
- [kestrel/tripadvisor-restaurant-reviews](https://mtedj.github.io/kestrel-actors-examples/agents/tripadvisor-restaurant-reviews/): TripAdvisor restaurant reviews and attraction reviews by URL or name. One row per review: bubbles, text, food, service, value, atmosphere ratings, visit date, diner tips, photos, owner reply. Free location row: rating, review count, cuisine, menu, hours. Filters: negative reviews, new reviews only.
- [kestrel/tripadvisor-reviews-scraper](https://mtedj.github.io/kestrel-actors-examples/agents/tripadvisor-reviews-scraper/): TripAdvisor hotel reviews and TripAdvisor ratings by URL, id or name. One row per review: bubbles, title, text, six sub-ratings, stay date, trip type, reviewer, photos, management response. Free hotel row: rating, review count, city ranking. Filters: negative reviews, new reviews only. 24 languages.
- [kestrel/trustpilot-reviews-scraper](https://mtedj.github.io/kestrel-actors-examples/agents/trustpilot-reviews-scraper/): Trustpilot customer reviews by domain or URL. Each review: rating, title, text, dates, country, verified label, company reply. Free: TrustScore, star histogram, email, phone. Filter negative reviews, date, language and keyword before billing. Repeat windows can overlap; dedupe review_id downstream.
- [kestrel/website-email-finder](https://mtedj.github.io/kestrel-actors-examples/agents/website-email-finder/): Extract public email contacts from supplied websites and linked contact pages. One row per website/email: address, source page and page title. Bounded same-site crawl; free duplicates and ID/hash exclusions. 网站邮箱提取。 No guessed addresses, private profiles or mailbox verification.
- [kestrel/website-screenshot-capture](https://mtedj.github.io/kestrel-actors-examples/agents/website-screenshot-capture/): Capture website screenshots as PNG downloads with desktop or mobile viewport sizes. Each URL returns title, dimensions, source and download link. Full-page capture capped at 12,000 pixels; blocked requests are reported. 网页截图。 No login, POST actions, cookies or unrestricted network access.
- [kestrel/workday-company-jobs](https://mtedj.github.io/kestrel-actors-examples/agents/workday-company-jobs/): Collect Workday jobs from company career URLs with keyword search. Each job includes title, company, location, requisition ID, description and apply URL. Free location/text filters and ID/hash exclusions. Public employer job boards; no global company discovery. 招聘职位。
- [kestrel/yahoo-finance-price-history](https://mtedj.github.io/kestrel-actors-examples/agents/yahoo-finance-price-history/): Fetch Yahoo Finance historical prices by ticker and date range. One row per daily bar: open, high, low, close, volume, adjusted close, dividends, splits and currency. Stocks, ETFs, forex and crypto. Monitor new or changed bars; successful history checks are billed even with no new rows.
- [kestrel/youtube-channel-videos](https://mtedj.github.io/kestrel-actors-examples/agents/youtube-channel-videos/): List YouTube channel videos from handles, IDs or channel URLs. Each upload includes title, URL, views, video duration, thumbnail and published text. Filter titles, minimum views and duration; monitor new uploads. Parsed pages are billed even when filters or monitoring leave no rows.
- [kestrel/zillow-property-search](https://mtedj.github.io/kestrel-actors-examples/agents/zillow-property-search/): Search Zillow real estate from city URLs: property listings and rental buildings with unit options. Each row has address, price, beds, baths, area, status and URL. Filter price and bedrooms; monitor new listings and price changes. Parsed pages are billed even with no matching rows.
